Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried out every six months as 
indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The function of the gate shaft water level 
indicator is to show the level of water inside the gate shaft.
The first draft 
was initiated and tested by eng. Kamal Amin Gad Allah, accepted by general 
director eng. Atty Sefen Rizk Allah, 
approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abdel-Baset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should well trained, qualified or 
 directly supervised by some one.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area are required
Personal protective equipment must be used
Tools and 
Equipment
Work to be Carried out
Clean the measuring shaft there should be no foreign object in the shaft which 
would hinder the float motion
Check the reference point (i.e) the max level point must be visually marked in 
the measuring shaft for that purpose pull the float by hand to the max level 
point and check on the local indication scale that the value on the scale agrees 
with level at which the float is placed.
